links.outcome: Citation credibility of LLM responses to drug information questions
links.effect: Citation credibility fulfillment ranged 0.03-0.36 across seven LLMs, while concordance with pharmacist answers ranged 0.70-0.86.
links.quote: Concordance was more variable, ranging from 0.70-0.86, whereas citation credibility was consistently weak, ranging from 0.03-0.36.

screen.reason: The study evaluated seven LLMs on 102 real-world drug information questions from a university hospital to assess concordance with pharmacist responses, clarity, and citation credibility without testing an explicit deployment practice.
